title: "Sabotage": Experts, lawmakers blast RFK Jr. for destroying healthcare research
gist: Experts and 30 Democratic senators accuse the Trump administration and Health Secretary RFK Jr. of 'sabotaging' the Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ) by cutting 75 percent of staff, canceling over 100 grants worth $250M+, and leaving most of a $345M congressional appropriation unspent.

insights.claim: DOGE cuts led to firing or retirement of an estimated 75 percent of AHRQ staff, and in July the agency canceled over 100 research grants collectively worth more than $250 million across 30+ states.
insights.speaker: Beth Mole
insights.so_what: Gutting of federal health-services research affects the evidence base for care delivery and healthcare-cost improvement—relevant to health-sector policy risk.

insights.claim: Congress appropriated $345 million to AHRQ for fiscal 2026 but only $15 million has gone to grants, with much of the funding refused despite legal appropriation.
insights.speaker: Beth Mole
insights.so_what: Executive refusal to spend appropriated funds is a constitutional/impoundment flashpoint with implications for agency continuity.

insights.claim: 30 Democratic senators called RFK Jr.'s handling of AHRQ 'sabotage' and an 'outrageous abuse of administrative power,' demanding he rescind the cancellations by August 25.
insights.speaker: Beth Mole
insights.so_what: Escalating political conflict over health-agency funding; watch the August 25 deadline and any legal challenge.
insights.quote: outrageous abuse of administrative power that will leave Americans sicker, poorer, and dying from preventable causes
